VERDICT: Approved for staging; the redesign correctly isolates SCM identity via content-addressed pins and controller-owned API attestations, eliminating the prior script-writable bypass.
ACTION ITEMS: Verify the `validate-scm-execution.py` regex strictly rejects multi-line or padded SHA-1s in live receipts; confirm `FOGELL_SCM_ATTESTATION` is unset in non-probe production runs to prevent accidental engine-note injection.
JENKINS AUTHORITY: Jenkins attests exclusively via the `git-plugin` BuildData API SHA1 actions, ensuring the revision is controller-owned and immune to script-writable console text spoofing.
FOGELL AUTHORITY: Fogell SCM jobs attest the exact revision, tree, and Jenkinsfile blob captured in the private fetch, while git-step execution emits notes only after successful checkout or canonically `not-executed`.
LIVE REQUIREMENT: A future live recapture is required to validate the new `FOGELL_GIT_PINNED_BRANCH` rendering and `scm-execution.tsv` generation against a real Jenkins controller and remote SCM.
